product_overview: A job marketplace platform where candidates can search and apply for jobs, manage profiles and resumes, and track application progress. Employers can post jobs and review applicants, while administrators oversee platform activity and manage users and listings.
core_goals: Apply for and manage job applications
Build and export a professional resume
Maintain and update a job seeker profile
Create and manage company job listings
Review and manage applicants as an employer
Administer platform users, jobs, companies, and applications

features.name: Candidate & Company Authentication
features.description: Users can register and sign in as either job seekers or company representatives, then access the appropriate area of the platform.
user_flows: Navigate to /signup -> Choose a job seeker or company role -> Fill in the registration details -> Submit the registration form -> See the login page
Navigate to /login -> Enter email and password -> Submit the login form -> See the appropriate dashboard or destination after authentication
Navigate to /login -> Enter incorrect credentials -> Submit the login form -> See validation or access failure feedback

features.name: Job Discovery & Application
features.description: Job seekers can search for jobs, browse paginated listings, inspect job details, save jobs, apply to openings, and withdraw active applications.
user_flows: Navigate to /jobs -> Browse the job listings -> Open a job to view full details -> Apply for the job -> See application confirmation
Navigate to /jobs -> Enter a search term -> Review the filtered results -> Open a matching job -> Apply for the job -> See application confirmation
Navigate to /jobs -> Browse the job listings -> Save a job for later -> Open saved job details -> Remove the saved job from bookmarks
Navigate to /jobs -> Open a job already applied to -> Withdraw the application -> See the application removed from the active list
Navigate to /jobs -> Move to another page of results -> Continue browsing additional listings

features.name: Company Directory
features.description: Users can browse registered companies, inspect company profiles, and view the open roles associated with each employer.
user_flows: Navigate to /companies -> Browse the company directory -> Open a company profile -> Review the company description and active job openings
Navigate to /companies -> Open a company profile -> Select an open role -> Apply for the job -> See application confirmation

features.name: User Profile & Application Tracker
features.description: Authenticated job seekers can review profile completion, update personal information, and track applications and saved jobs in one place.
user_flows: Navigate to /profile -> Review profile progress and summary -> Switch to applied jobs -> Review application statuses -> Switch to saved jobs -> Review bookmarked listings
Navigate to /profile -> Update phone, skills, experience, education, or career goal -> Save the profile changes -> See the updated profile information
Navigate to /profile -> Open saved jobs -> Remove a saved job -> See it disappear from the saved list
Navigate to /profile -> Choose to delete the account -> Confirm the deletion -> See the account removed from the platform

features.name: Resume Builder & PDF Export
features.description: Authenticated job seekers can create a resume, fill in work and education details, validate entries, save a local draft, and export the result as a PDF.
user_flows: Navigate to /resume -> Fill in the resume header and contact details -> Add work experience, education, skills, and summary -> Validate the required information -> Save the draft locally
Navigate to /resume -> Fill in the resume sections -> Review the live preview -> Export the resume as PDF -> Download the document
Navigate to /resume -> Leave required fields empty or exceed character limits -> Validate the resume -> See form validation feedback

features.name: Employer Dashboard
features.description: Company representatives can manage their profile, create or update job postings, and review applicants while changing application statuses.
user_flows: Navigate to /company-dashboard -> Switch to Post Job -> Fill in the job details -> Submit the posting -> See the new job listed
Navigate to /company-dashboard -> Switch to My Jobs -> Open an existing job -> Update the job details -> Save the changes -> See the updated listing
Navigate to /company-dashboard -> Switch to Applications -> Open an applicant submission -> Review the resume and details -> Change the application status -> See the updated status badge
Navigate to /company-dashboard -> Switch to Profile -> Update company information or logo -> Save the changes -> See the refreshed company profile

features.name: Administrator Control Console
features.description: Administrators can sign in to the admin area, review platform metrics, manage jobs and accounts, and inspect application activity.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Sign in with admin credentials -> View system metrics and activity charts -> Review the platform overview
Navigate to /admin -> Search for a job, user, or company -> Open the matching record -> Edit or delete the item -> See the updated admin listing
Navigate to /admin -> Open the applications view -> Review platform-wide applications -> Inspect application details -> Return to the dashboard overview

features.name: Real-Time Notifications
features.description: Authenticated users can receive live alerts about application status changes and manage unread notifications from the notification panel.
user_flows: Receive a real-time notification -> Open the notification panel -> Review recent alerts -> Mark a notification as read -> See it removed from the unread state
Receive a real-time application status update -> See a toast alert appear -> Open the notification panel -> Review the update details

routes.description: Landing page featuring job search, category browsing, statistics, and featured listings
User authentication login page with role-based redirection
Registration page for job seekers and company representatives
Job discovery page with keyword search, pagination, detailed job drawer, and apply/save actions
Directory of registered companies with details and list of open roles
About page detailing the mission, features, and platform metrics
User profile management with profile completion tracker, application history, and saved jobs
Interactive resume builder with section forms, live preview, and PDF download
Admin portal for system metrics, job listings, registered users, companies, and applications
Employer dashboard for posting and updating jobs, reviewing applicants, and editing company profile

features.name: Candidate & Company Authentication
features.description: User registration and login with JWT access token handling and role-based access
user_interactions: Enter email and password credentials
Submit login form to authenticate
Select between Job Seeker and Company roles on registration
Fill in personal or organizational registration fields
Submit registration and redirect to dashboard or login
Log out from navigation bar

features.name: Job Discovery & Application
features.description: Search, filter, inspect details, bookmark, apply for jobs, and withdraw applications
user_interactions: Type search terms in the job search input
Click on job cards to view full requirements and company information
Toggle bookmark icon to save or unsave jobs
Click Apply Now button to submit an application
Click Withdraw button to retract an active application
Click page numbers to browse paginated listings

features.name: Company Directory
features.description: Browse list of hiring companies, view their profiles, and explore open jobs
user_interactions: Browse list of verified companies with logo, description, and website
Select a company to view active job openings
Apply directly to open positions from the company profile view

features.name: User Profile & Application Tracker
features.description: Manage personal details, career goals, resume upload, and monitor job application statuses
user_interactions: View profile progress indicator and summary
Edit phone, skills, experience, education, and career goal
Switch tabs between Overview, Applied Jobs, and Saved Jobs
Track application status badges (Applied, Under Review, Interview, Rejected, Accepted)
Remove or manage saved job listings
Delete account

features.name: Resume Builder & PDF Export
features.description: Create and format professional resumes with validation and export to PDF
user_interactions: Fill in resume header and contact details
Add work experience, education, skills, and summary
Validate required fields and character length
Save resume draft locally
Click Export PDF to download compiled resume document

features.name: Employer Dashboard
features.description: Manage job listings, review submitted applications, and update hiring statuses
user_interactions: Switch dashboard views between Overview, My Jobs, Post Job, Applications, and Profile
Fill job creation form (title, description, location, salary, tags, requirements)
Submit new job posting or update existing listing
Review applicant resumes and details
Change applicant status (Reviewed, Interview, Accepted, Rejected)
Update company profile information and logo

features.name: Administrator Control Console
features.description: System administration for monitoring metrics, managing users, reviewing listings, and external sync
user_interactions: Admin login with dedicated credentials
View overview charts and counters (Total Users, Jobs, Companies, Applications)
Inspect, edit, and delete job postings
Search and manage registered candidate and company accounts
Review platform-wide job applications

features.name: Real-Time Notifications
features.description: STOMP/SockJS WebSocket connection for live application updates and system notifications
user_interactions: Receive real-time push toast alerts when application status changes
Open notification bell dropdown to view recent alerts
Mark notifications as read

known_limitations.issue: Resume builder saves drafts to localStorage instead of remote backend database
known_limitations.impact: Resumes are stored on the local browser client and do not synchronize across devices
